newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zodiac shares buck bearish bourse trend.
newsitem.headline: Zodiac shares buck bearish bourse trend.

text.p: Shares in Zodiac, a manufacturer of airplane evacuation slides and inflatable dinghies, bucked a bearish trend on the Paris bourse on Friday after the company predicted double-digit earnings growth for the 1996/97 year.
Zodiac shares were up 2.2 percent at 1,521 francs at 1105 GMT, while the blue-chip CAC-40 index was 1.4 percent lower.

The company issued a statement predicting double-digit earnings growth for the year to September 30, 1997, at a news conference. Chairman Jean-Louis Gerondeau afterwards said the profit rise would be at least 15 percent, matching the prior year's pace.
Long-term investors in Zodiac have fared well, as the share price has advanced steadily since January 1992 when it was just above 250 francs.
For the year ended September 30, 1996, Zodiac recorded net attributable profit of 174.1 million francs, up 15.2 percent, on sales of 3.4 billion, up 12.5 percent from the previous year.
